# doyouknow.app

> Bilingual (English and Arabic) explainers, surprising facts and practical guides about the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt and the wider world. Every English article has an Arabic counterpart at the same slug under /ar/.

Articles are written with AI-assisted editorial workflows and checked against the authoritative sources linked in each article's "Sources" section; health, finance, legal, religious and government-procedure pages need documented owner review before publication. We do not publish politics/conflict advocacy, allegations about people or organizations, or gambling content. When citing a fact, please link the article page and prefer the primary source it cites.

## About

- [About and editorial policy](https://doyouknow.app/en/about.html): Who runs doyouknow.app, how articles are researched, sourced, written and corrected.
- [عن الموقع وسياسة التحرير](https://doyouknow.app/ar/about.html): Arabic version of the about and editorial policy page.
- [Contact](https://doyouknow.app/en/contact.html): Corrections and questions (hello@doyouknow.app).

## Latest articles (English)

- [How Earthquake Magnitude Is Actually Measured](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-earthquake-magnitude-is-actually-measured.html): Magnitude is not a damage score but a logarithmic measure of the energy a fault releases, and the scale behind the number has moved from Richter to moment magnitude.
- [How to Check a University Is Accredited in the UAE](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-to-check-a-university-is-accredited-in-the-uae.html): Before you pay a dirham, run two official checks: the federal CAA register for the institution and its programmes, and the KHDA directory for Dubai campuses.
- [Cairo Uber and Careem Taxi Guide](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/cairo-uber-careem-taxi-guide.html): How Uber and Careem work in Cairo: pricing, car types, airport pickup, and how they compare to street taxis.
- [Dubai Freelance Permit Guide](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/dubai-freelance-permit-guide.html): Dubai's freelance permit lets independent professionals work legally without a company. Here is how the process, authorities, and costs actually break down.
- [How B12 Deficiency Actually Affects Vegans and Vegetarians](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-b12-deficiency-actually-affects-vegans-and-vegetarians.html): B12 comes almost only from animal foods. Here's why vegans are genuinely at risk, the real symptoms, and how much to supplement.
- [How Business Incubators and Accelerators Actually Work](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-business-incubators-and-accelerators-actually-work.html): Accelerators run fixed-term cohorts for equity, like Y Combinator. Incubators offer open-ended support. Here is the real difference.
- [How Child Life Specialists Actually Help Kids in Hospitals](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-child-life-specialists-actually-help-kids-in-hospitals.html): Child life specialists use play and honest explanation to help hospitalized kids and families cope with medical stress.
- [How Digital Signatures Actually Verify a Document's Authenticity](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-digital-signatures-actually-verify-a-documents-authenticity.html): A digital signature hashes a document, encrypts the hash with a private key, and lets anyone verify it with the matching public key.
- [How Diplomatic Immunity Actually Works](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-diplomatic-immunity-actually-works.html): Diplomatic immunity is real but limited: it belongs to the state, can be waived, and does not block expulsion for crimes.
- [How Esports Team Sponsorship Deals Actually Work](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-esports-team-sponsorship-deals-actually-work.html): How esports orgs turn jersey logos, content deals, and streaming exposure into their single biggest source of revenue.
- [How Film Color Grading Actually Shapes Mood](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-film-color-grading-actually-shapes-mood.html): How colorists use color grading, not just correction, to make a scene feel cold, dangerous, nostalgic, or warm on screen.
- [How Mesh WiFi Systems Actually Cover a Whole House](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-mesh-wifi-systems-actually-cover-a-whole-house.html): Mesh WiFi covers a house with multiple nodes sharing one network, roaming seamlessly and rerouting automatically when a node drops.
- [How National Flag Colors Carry Different Symbolism Worldwide](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-national-flag-colors-actually-carry-different-symbolism-across-countries.html): The same flag colors mean very different things worldwide, shaped by shared political movements, not any single fixed rulebook.
- [How Power Naps Actually Affect Brain Performance](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-power-naps-actually-affect-brain-performance.html): Power naps can boost alertness and memory, but nap length matters. Here is what sleep science says about the ideal duration.
- [How Progressive Muscle Relaxation Actually Works](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-progressive-muscle-relaxation-actually-works.html): Progressive muscle relaxation eases anxiety by deliberately tensing then releasing muscle groups. Here is the science behind why it works.
- [How Satellite Constellations Avoid Colliding With Each Other](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-satellite-constellations-avoid-colliding-with-each-other.html): How satellites like Starlink dodge each other in orbit: conjunction data, risk thresholds, and autonomous avoidance burns.
- [How Saudi Arabia's Female Labor Target Changed the Job Market](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-saudi-arabias-female-labor-force-participation-target-actually-changed-the-job-market.html): Saudi Arabia hit its 30% female workforce target nine years early. Now it's aiming for 40%. Here's what actually drove the change.
- [How Saudi Arabia's Hajj and Umrah Capacity Expansion Works](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-saudi-arabias-hajj-and-umrah-capacity-expansion-actually-works.html): Saudi Arabia is racing toward 30 million Hajj and Umrah pilgrims a year by 2030. Here's the rail, hotels and tech making it possible.
- [How Screen Mirroring Sends Your Display to Another Screen](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-screen-mirroring-actually-sends-your-display-to-another-screen.html): How AirPlay, Chromecast, and Miracast each send your screen to a TV: different protocols, networks, and codecs.
- [How Smart Home Hubs Coordinate Different Device Brands](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-smart-home-hubs-actually-coordinate-different-brands-of-devices.html): Smart home hubs translate between brands using shared radios and the Matter standard, letting a Google, Apple, and Amazon device share one app.
- [How the World Happiness Report Actually Ranks Countries](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-the-world-happiness-report-actually-ranks-countries.html): The World Happiness Report doesn't add up six factors into a score. Here is what it actually measures and how the ranking really works.
- [How Trade Shows and Expos Actually Generate Revenue](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-trade-shows-and-expos-actually-generate-revenue-for-organizers.html): Trade shows run on booth rentals, sponsorship tiers, and ticket sales. Here is the real revenue model behind expo organizers.
- [How Trademark Registration Actually Protects a Brand](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-trademark-registration-actually-protects-a-brand.html): Trademark registration protects brand names and logos as source identifiers, distinct from copyright and patent law, through use and renewal rules.
- [How Undersea Internet Cables Actually Connect the World](https://doyouknow.app/en/article/how-undersea-internet-cables-actually-connect-the-world.html): Satellites barely register. Roughly 99% of intercontinental internet traffic runs through cables lying on the ocean floor. Here's how.

- [كيف تتجنب أقمار المجموعات الصناعية الاصطدام ببعضها فعلياً](https://doyouknow.app/ar/article/how-satellite-constellations-avoid-colliding-with-each-other.html): كيف تتجنب الأقمار الصناعية مثل ستارلينك الاصطدام في الفضاء: بيانات التقارب وحدود الخطر ومناورات التجنب الذاتية.
- [كيف غيّر هدف مشاركة المرأة في العمل سوق الوظائف بالسعودية](https://doyouknow.app/ar/article/how-saudi-arabias-female-labor-force-participation-target-actually-changed-the-job-market.html): السعودية حققت هدف 30% لمشاركة المرأة في العمل قبل موعده بتسع سنوات، والهدف الجديد 40%. هذا ما غيّر سوق العمل فعليًا.
- [كيف يعمل توسيع القدرة الاستيعابية للحج والعمرة في السعودية](https://doyouknow.app/ar/article/how-saudi-arabias-hajj-and-umrah-capacity-expansion-actually-works.html): السعودية تسعى لاستقبال 30 مليون معتمر وحاج سنويًا بحلول 2030. هذه القطارات والفنادق والتقنيات التي تجعل ذلك ممكنًا.
- [كيف يرسل مطابقة الشاشة عرضك إلى شاشة أخرى فعلياً](https://doyouknow.app/ar/article/how-screen-mirroring-actually-sends-your-display-to-another-screen.html): كيف يرسل AirPlay وChromecast وMiracast شاشتك إلى تلفاز: بروتوكولات وشبكات وترميزات مختلفة تماماً.
- [كيف تنسق محاور المنزل الذكي بين أجهزة العلامات المختلفة](https://doyouknow.app/ar/article/how-smart-home-hubs-actually-coordinate-different-brands-of-devices.html): تترجم مراكز المنزل الذكي بين الماركات عبر راديوهات مشتركة ومعيار Matter، فيعمل جهاز جوجل وآبل وأمازون من تطبيق واحد.
- [كيف يصنف تقرير السعادة العالمي الدول فعلياً](https://doyouknow.app/ar/article/how-the-world-happiness-report-actually-ranks-countries.html): تقرير السعادة العالمي لا يجمع ستة عوامل لينتج الترتيب. إليك ما يقيسه فعليًا وكيف يُحسب الترتيب حقًا.
- [كيف تحقق المعارض التجارية إيرادات لمنظميها فعلياً](https://doyouknow.app/ar/article/how-trade-shows-and-expos-actually-generate-revenue-for-organizers.html): تعتمد المعارض التجارية على إيجار الأجنحة والرعاية وتذاكر الحضور. إليك نموذج الإيرادات الحقيقي لمنظمي المعارض.
- [كيف يحمي تسجيل العلامة التجارية العلامة فعلياً](https://doyouknow.app/ar/article/how-trademark-registration-actually-protects-a-brand.html): تسجيل العلامة التجارية يحمي أسماء العلامات وشعاراتها كمحددات مصدر، بخلاف حق النشر وبراءة الاختراع، عبر قواعد الاستخدام والتجديد.
- [كيف تربط الكابلات البحرية العالم بالإنترنت فعلياً](https://doyouknow.app/ar/article/how-undersea-internet-cables-actually-connect-the-world.html): الأقمار الصناعية دورها ضئيل جدًا. نحو 99% من حركة الإنترنت بين القارات تمر عبر كابلات على قاع المحيط. إليك كيف.
- [كيف تعمل تحديثات اليوم الأول لألعاب الفيديو فعلياً](https://doyouknow.app/ar/article/how-video-game-day-one-patches-actually-work.html): لماذا تحتاج الألعاب الجديدة لتحديث ضخم قبل اللعب، وكيف تتعاون الأقراص والفحص والخوادم لتحقيق ذلك.
